title: BYD Launches Da Han Flagship Sedan: 1,008 km Range, 2nd-Gen Blade Battery Flash Charging
detail: BYD officially launched the Da Han, its most luxurious sedan to date, at the Chengdu Auto Show on August 22, 2026 (presales opened August 21), pricing from ¥249,900 (~US$37,170). All variants use a 102 kWh second-generation Blade Battery (LFP chemistry) rated for up to 1,008 km CLTC range, and support BYD's Flash Charging technology — 10-70% in 5 minutes and 10-97% in 9 minutes, requiring BYD's new high-power charging stations. The 5.26-meter sedan offers up to 570 kW combined dual-motor output, rear-wheel steering, and dual-chamber air suspension. The launch underscores LFP's continued push into flagship/premium segments long assumed to require higher-energy-density NMC chemistry.
